title: Lattice Configuration
description: Schema for lattice.json, the root configuration file of a Lattice monorepo. Workspaces are declared as objects with literal paths; globs are not accepted.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON Schema (e.g. ".lattice/schema.json").

latticeVersion.description: The version of Lattice this repo runs. An installed binary that is not this version installs it and hands over, so everyone gets the same build.

workspaces.description: Explicitly declared workspaces. Each entry is a single project directory (no globs).

engines.description: Root-level toolchain defaults for all workspaces.

globalDependencies.description: Repo-root-relative globs hashed into every task's cache key. Use for files shared across workspaces, such as a base tsconfig, a schema directory, or a root .env.

globalEnv.description: Environment variable names whose values are hashed into every task's cache key.

tasks.description: Named tasks and how they relate across the workspace graph.

path.description: Literal directory path (relative to repo root) to the workspace. Never a glob.

auto.description: When true (default), infer engine and task commands from the native manifest.

engines.description: Per-workspace toolchain constraints; overrides/pins the inferred engine.

dependsOn.description: Other workspaces (by name) this one depends on.

engines.description: Name-keyed map of engine constraints. Each value is either a version constraint string or a detailed engine spec object.

versionCmd.description: Command that prints the tool's version (e.g. "g++ --version").

installCmd.description: Command used to install the toolchain.

bin.description: Bin directory relative to the toolchain install.

dependsOn.description: Task dependencies. `^task` means the same task in dependency workspaces.

inputs.description: File globs hashed to determine cache keys.

outputs.description: File globs captured as cached artifacts.

ignore.description: File globs excluded from input hashing.

env.description: Environment variable names that affect the task's cache key.

persistent.description: When true, the task is long-running (e.g. a dev server) and never cached.

cache.description: Whether outputs of this task are cached.

timeout.description: How long the task may run before it is killed, e.g. "90s", "10m", "1h", or a number of seconds. Ignored for persistent tasks.

maxCacheSize.description: Upper bound on the local cache size (e.g. "10GB").

cacheDir.description: Directory for the local cache (defaults to ".lattice/cache").

versionCheck.description: When true (default), compare the running binary against latticeVersion. Set false to run whatever binary is invoked.
